scope: Foreground/background/boundary memory-token study; excludes superseded latent-utility claims
running_kaggle: Leave the pinned frame-matched E2 job unchanged
primary_question: Do explicit regions add information beyond proximity, and does their effect depend on memory corruption?

model.initialization: first labeled visible-frame GT mask once; no detector corrections
model.memory: native seven-frame memory settings, object pointers on

geometry.contour: inner contour of occupied grid, 3x3 erosion, outside-image background
geometry.distance: Euclidean token-centre distance to inner contour; negative inside; undefined for empty mask
geometry.controls: disjoint, no replacement; preserve frame and absolute-distance-bin counts; no relaxed matching
geometry.infeasible: record and skip, never silently shrink full boundary budget

local_plan.A1_feasibility: All 21 promptable PolypGen sequences; oracle GT geometry only, no prediction or performance claim; report full-budget and support counts
local_plan.MPS_validation: seq2 prefix, 12 frames from prompt, independent native and zero-controller rollouts; require bit-identical logits before diagnosis
local_plan.Bplus_diagnosis: seq13 and seq14, natural propagation and all spatial keys suppressed; same single mask prompt; pointers retained
local_plan.sampled_counterfactual: After fresh validation, eight dev sequences seq2-6,8-10; two index-selected targets (first eligible and last); independent c0,c1,c2,natural spatial-bank reconstructions at each target; preserve natural pointers and history outside selected bank. Existing corruption operators and equal-budget interventions, five random seeds, conditioning/recent separate. Includes fixed oracle category supports, recorded overlap, signed query-region Dice harm. This is a sampled matched-bank perturbation experiment, not accumulated corrupted rollouts or full A3.
local_plan.persistent_followup: After the sampled counterfactuals, seq13/14 only if the completed B+ native baseline has a failure episode. Reuse persistent_region_rollout: recent-bank boundary, foreground, near_background, far_background and five uniform-random seeds, all at the current boundary token budget; predicted-mask categories recomputed after each native memory write; conditioning and pointers unchanged. Record infeasible reads with no intervention. First run a 12-frame prefix to validate the adapter, then full intervals if it passes. Descriptive two-sequence A4 follow-up only; no unique error attribution or population significance.
local_plan.diagnosis_interpretation: Spatial suppression is not complete memory-off and may remove target identity. Differences do not alone prove errors were carried by a particular region.
local_plan.deadline_policy: Stop cleanly at a frame boundary; retain partial results with completed=false; never claim whole-sequence coverage from a prefix

analysis.unit: sequence; frames and training seeds are not independent units
analysis.inference: n=2 diagnosis is descriptive only; no population significance claim
analysis.multiple_comparisons: Holm within prespecified endpoint families; whole-sequence bootstrap
analysis.success_safety: Future method claims require non-inferiority with a prospectively fixed margin, not failure to reject loss

next_gates: Audit disjoint-control feasibility before A1 intervention collection
Finish unchanged E2 and verify terminal delivery
Multi-sequence A3 c0/c1/c2/natural with matched targets and documented masks; no monotonicity assumption
Define local helpfulness endpoints, not merely absolute logit changes
A4 only after B+ natural failures; region recovery is non-additive and not unique error attribution
Verify dataset sequence provenance, gaps and patient/source groups before cross-domain evaluation
Keep domains separate for primary inference

arms: M1 plus side and mixed coverage
requirements: zero-init forward equivalence and connected gradients
method_not_yet_authorized_as_validated.claim: Region-aware value requires beating geometry-free, distance-only and shuffled controls on fresh evaluation, with success safety and all-frame results
method_not_yet_authorized_as_validated.not_claimed: No promised gain over 0.77; no claim of implemented v2 rollout trainer
